name: Taormina
tagline: Greek theatre above the sea with Etna behind
summary: Taormina is a Sicilian hill town on a terrace above the Ionian Sea, with Mount Etna smoking in the distance. Sit in the Greek theatre for one of the world's great views, stroll the Corso Umberto, take the cable car down to Isola Bella, and day-trip to Etna's craters and the Alcantara gorges.
seasonNote: Spring and early autumn; July and August are busy, and the theatre hosts summer concerts.
arrival: Catania airport is about 1 hour by bus; trains stop at Taormina-Giardini below the town.
gettingAround: Walk the town; cable car to the beach; buses or tours for Etna.
cashTip: Cards are widely accepted, but carry cash for bars, markets and small trattorie. A coperto (cover charge) is normal; tipping is optional.
foodTip: Granita with brioche, arancini, cannoli and pasta alla Norma.
buyTip: Ceramic heads (teste di moro) and Etna wines.

connections.note: Frequent buses from the airport and city.
